name: Generalize Exercise Types and Import Full ODS Catalogue
objective: Support arbitrary multi-valued exercise types and replace the three-record PoC with the complete 20-record ODS catalogue across parsing, conversion, storage, UI, and tests.
exit_criteria: Exercise types support arbitrary ordered values, including multiple semicolon-delimited source values, without reducing them to Strength or Stretch.
The complete ODS catalogue imports exactly 20 unique exercises with deterministic IDs and no three-record PoC data or references.
Source category text remains complete in category, while evidence and source fields stay outside the user-facing Exercise model.
Parser, converter, storage, routine, UI, and integration tests cover the expanded model and pass.
The web project passes the full test suite, lint, and production build.
